text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan got hurt. She looked like she 
was in a lot of pain at that moment, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Doctor. Thanks to 
you, it doesn't hurt at aaall anymore.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, with a smile like that, you look 
just fine. I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A mascot's job is also to create smiles. I 
won't do anything that causes worry.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! How about we try running for a 
bit? If I show you that I'm completely 
fine, that'll put you at ease, right?
choice_data_list: Still, I'm worried, so let's rest...

...If I decide it's too much, I'm stopping 
you.

...If I decide it's too much, I'll stop 
you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! How about we try running for a 
bit? If I show you that I'm completely 
fine, that'll put you at ease, right?
choice_data_list: Still, I'm worried, so let's rest...

...If I decide it's too much, I'm stopping 
you.

...If I decide it's too much, I'll stop 
you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is that so... Let's do that, then.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I will get well and return soon. Switching 
to the Chan Revival Route.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm off to night-night sleep. See 
ya later~

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Feast your eyes upon the 
indomitable Chan-Mei~

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A wise figure of the past once said, 
'Courage and recklessness are two very 
different things.'

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Machan cannot allow everyone to find 
out about that."

Perhaps thinking that continuing any 
longer would only increase everyone's 
worry... she voluntarily returned to the 
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. Thanks to the nurse, it feels like 
running at this pace will be totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Let's go thank them properly. We shall 
deliver Machan's smile."

Aston Machan overcame her injury with a 
smile, and her comeback went as smoothly 
as could be.
